Good People Should Meet Good People

What happens when you meet the right person at the right time under the right context? We interview entrepreneurs, creatives, and professionals doing great work in their fields and communities who have something to teach us. Every good person should meet the people below.

Episode 3

Shanna Pearre and Darean Rhodes

Three Best Friends Launch A Non-Alcoholic Alternative, Sensori

Scooter sits down with Sensori co-founders Shanna Pearre and Darean Rhodes to trace the friendship behind their functional non-alcoholic beverage brand, from seventh grade to launching a company together. They unpack the chaos and magic of building with close friends, while acknowledging fellow co-founder and CMO Ashlyn Knox, who could not join the recording.
